independent.derivation: Independently derived values; no upstream token values or prose copied.

rationale: Content cards start near 18rem; breakpoints add columns only after allowing gaps and gutters.
use: Start here, then move breakpoints where real content stops fitting.
avoid: Do not infer device categories or promise that desktop layouts work on native unchanged. CSS custom properties cannot supply media-query conditions.

--ds-breakpoint-small.derivation: Rounded content capacity threshold: start near 18rem per card plus gaps/gutters.

--ds-breakpoint-medium.derivation: Rounded content capacity threshold: start near 18rem per card plus gaps/gutters.

--ds-breakpoint-large.derivation: Rounded content capacity threshold: start near 18rem per card plus gaps/gutters.

--ds-grid-max.derivation: Independent maximum working width; wide viewports retain side margins.

--ds-grid-gutter.derivation: 24px outer gutter; narrow layouts must preserve available content width.

--ds-grid-columns-0.derivation: Column count for the corresponding ordered width state.

--ds-grid-columns-1.derivation: Column count for the corresponding ordered width state.

--ds-grid-columns-2.derivation: Column count for the corresponding ordered width state.

guidance: Resolve width from the viewport or an explicitly chosen container, never from device names. The specimen simulates a viewport in a scrollable region; its inner grid retains the maximum content width.
